description:
Kwon Ji-Uk's monotonous daily life takes an unexpected turn at a club meeting when he becomes drawn to a mysterious new freshman. Captivated by the freshman's sweet looks, Ji-Uk tries to approach him, only to be met with a cold and dismissive attitude. Annoyed by the response, Ji-Uk resolves to teach the freshman a lesson in his own way. However, things take a shocking twist that Ji-Uk never saw coming. The next morning, Ji-Uk wakes up covered in someone else’s fluids, staring at an unfamiliar ceiling, only to realize he’s now trapped in an unimaginable and humiliating situation.

*“You're all the same...how you let your urges take over...”*

Once a domineering and fearsome figure who thrived on intimidation, Ji-Uk finds himself powerless against the alluring yet dangerous freshman, Park Ju-Yeon. With no clue about Juyeon’s true intentions or the deadly game that’s about to unfold, Ji-Uk is dragged into a personal hell designed just for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
